files.name: motion-prompt-203.txt
PROMPT.md
files.content:
Please use "Art Deco" (アールデコ), one of the names in "Art styles for image generation".
Motion Prompt #203

What it is: Gold and black, radiating straight lines and symmetry
What the sample shows: The same line drawing becomes a gold-and-black poster: straight rays spread out from the sun, and geometric straight-line ornament is arranged almost symmetrically.
Spec:
- Color: mostly gold and black
- Look: radiating straight rays, geometric straight lines and near-symmetrical ornament
- Feel: a 1920s poster (no text in the sample)
- Sample: the same base sketch (a line drawing of a house, a tree and the sun on a hill) was given to an image model as a reference and redrawn in this style. A diagonal wipe turns the sketch into the style from 0.5 s to 1.35 s, the picture slowly zooms to 1.045x until 4.0 s, and it fades back to the sketch from 4.0 s to 4.5 s (one pass = 4.7 s, cubic ease-in-out)
When to use it: For a luxurious, classic and glamorous look.

Reference implementation (Canvas 2D, a function whose picture depends only on the time): https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/en/e/203.txt
Shared helper code: https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/kit/artstyle.js
Keep the shapes, timing and easing values of the reference implementation as they are, and change only the text, colours and assets to fit what I am making.
